item.title: K-Shape economy and the morality of wealth ownership
item.description:
Some thoughts from a breakfast conversation with my mum about wealth, financial freedom, and the increasingly difficult balance between looking after yourself and looking after others.
In a world that seems to reward individualism more than ever, is being a good person becoming a luxury we can no longer afford?
